checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
must.why: A single white leather low-top sneaker.

must.item: The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
must.why: Plain white with only a soft shadow; faint background mottling is barely visible.

must.item: The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
must.why: Whole shoe is in frame, though the left edge and right toe sit fairly close to the borders (about 40px).

must.item: No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.

faults.what: The shoe fills most of the frame, so the margins are tight, especially on the left and right.
The background has faint off-white mottling, and the white shoe has low contrast against it.
The 640px resolution is low for a marketplace listing.

summary: A clean square product shot of one white leather sneaker on a white background with a soft shadow; the only problems are tight margins and low resolution.
